Which size am I?

30-day returns, postage paid. Nothing on this site can actually be purchased.

Six panels, four of them on the true bias, so the dress takes the body's line without gripping it. Crepe twist in both warp and weft keeps it off the skin — the reason a bias dress in flat silk clings and this one does not.

Shown in size S on a 178 cm frame measuring 84–66–92.
